title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
description: Track cyber adversaries, analyze indicators of compromise (IoCs), leverage open-source intelligence (OSINT), and author strategic intelligence briefings.

goal.objective: Produce actionable tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence on adversary tactics to proactively defend organizational infrastructure.

learn.summary: Master intelligence lifecycles, STIX/TAXII standards, Threat Intelligence Platforms (MISP, OpenCTI), adversary attribution, Diamond Model of Intrusion, and OSINT tools.
key_competencies: Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis & MITRE ATT&CK
prerequisites: Strong research and analytical writing skills
